answer: An agent network can resist Sybil attacks using verifiable proof-of-space commitments. Inside an archival haven auditing items like an antique quill or carved onyx, agents authenticate identities by demonstrating continuous possession of unique storage plots. An attacker incurs the scarce physical cost of dedicating discrete non-volatile memory per identity. However, this model biases influence toward industrial data centers and degrades if adversaries dynamically lease cloud storage.
